name: corpus_v1
description: 100 English prompts, 20 per category, for qwen36 routing capture.

prompts.text: Write a Python function that returns the nth Fibonacci number using memoization.
Explain what a race condition is and give a short example in Go.
Write a SQL query that returns the top 5 customers by total order value.
What is the difference between a shallow copy and a deep copy in Python?
Write a bash one-liner that finds the 10 largest files under the current directory.
Implement a binary search over a sorted array in C.

Why does this JavaScript print 3 three times?
for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) { setTimeout(() => console.log(i), 0); }
Write a regular expression that matches a valid IPv4 address, and explain each part.
Explain the difference between a process and a thread.
Write a Rust function that reverses the order of words in a sentence.
What does the volatile keyword do in C, and when do you actually need it?
Write a Python decorator that retries a function up to three times when it raises.
Explain how a memory leak can still happen in a garbage-collected language.

Convert this callback style to async/await in JavaScript:
fs.readFile('a.txt', (err, data) => { if (err) throw err; console.log(data); });
Write a Dockerfile for a Python Flask app that listens on port 8000.
What is the average time complexity of a hash table insert, and when does it degrade?
Give the git commands to undo the last commit while keeping the changes staged.
Explain the difference between TCP and UDP for someone writing a multiplayer game server.
Write a Python class implementing a fixed-size LRU cache.
A train travels 120 km in 1.5 hours. What is its average speed, and how far would it travel in 4 hours at that speed?
Solve for x: 3x + 7 = 22. Show your steps.
What is the probability of rolling a sum of 7 with two fair six-sided dice? Explain the counting.
Prove that the sum of any two even integers is even.
A shirt costs $40 after a 20% discount. What was the original price?
How many distinct arrangements are there of the letters in the word BANANA?
If all Bloops are Razzies and all Razzies are Lazzies, are all Bloops Lazzies? Explain your reasoning.
A bat and a ball cost $1.10 together. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. How much does the ball cost?
What is the derivative of f(x) = x^3 * ln(x)?
Explain why the square root of 2 is irrational.
Five people each shake hands with every other person exactly once. How many handshakes occur?
A tank fills in 6 hours with one pipe and 4 hours with another. How long does it take with both open?
What is the sum of the first 100 positive integers, and what is the general formula?
If the probability of rain is 30% on each of three independent days, what is the probability of no rain at all?
Explain the difference between correlation and causation, with a concrete example.
A car loses 15% of its value each year. What fraction of the original value remains after 3 years?
Solve the system of equations: 2x + y = 10 and x - y = 2.
What is the next number in the sequence 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, and why?
Explain the pigeonhole principle and give one concrete application.
Three switches outside a room control three bulbs inside it. You may enter the room only once. How do you determine which switch controls which bulb?
Explain how photosynthesis works.
What were the main causes of the fall of the Western Roman Empire?
Describe the water cycle.
What is CRISPR and why was its discovery significant?
Explain how vaccines train the immune system.
What is the difference between weather and climate?
Describe how a nuclear reactor generates electricity.
Who was Ada Lovelace and why is she important in the history of computing?
Explain plate tectonics and what causes earthquakes.
What is inflation and what typically causes it?
Describe how the human circulatory system works.
What was the Marshall Plan and what did it achieve?
Explain what black holes are and how they form.
What is the difference between DNA and RNA?
Describe the main causes of the French Revolution.
How do antibiotics work, and why is antibiotic resistance a problem?
What is the greenhouse effect?
Explain the significance of the Rosetta Stone.
How does the internet route data between two distant computers?
Explain the theory of evolution by natural selection.
Write a short poem about autumn rain.
I'm nervous about a job interview tomorrow. Any advice?
Tell me a short bedtime story about a lighthouse keeper.
What's a good way to start a conversation with someone new at a party?
Write a haiku about the ocean.
My friend cancelled our plans last minute again. How should I bring it up with them?
Describe a bustling market using vivid sensory detail.
Suggest a fun weekend activity for a family with young children.
Write the opening paragraph of a mystery novel set in a small coastal town.
I've been feeling burned out at work lately. What might help?
Write a limerick about a cat who loves computers.
What are some good questions to ask on a first date?
Invent a short myth explaining why the moon changes shape.
Help me write a thank-you note to a mentor who is retiring.
Describe the feeling of finally finishing a long journey.
Write a short dialogue between two strangers stuck in an elevator.
Do you think people should keep journals? Why or why not?
Write a short toast for a friend's 30th birthday.
Describe a forest at dawn in exactly three sentences.
Give me an encouraging message for someone who is just learning to code.
Extract the name, age and city as JSON: "Maria Alvarez, 34, lives in Barcelona."
Convert this to CSV with headers name,role,years: "Ana is a designer with 6 years. Ben is an engineer with 3 years. Cleo is a manager with 11 years."
Extract all dates from the following and return them as a JSON array: "The contract was signed on 3 May 2019, amended 12 January 2020, and expires 30 June 2025."
Turn this into a JSON object with keys product, price and currency: "The mechanical keyboard retails for 89.99 EUR."
From "Flight BA249 departs London Heathrow at 14:35 and arrives in Sao Paulo at 22:10", extract flight_number, origin, destination, departure and arrival as JSON.

Extract every email address from: "Contact sam@acme.io or the team at support@acme.io; billing is handled by ap@vendor.co.uk."

Summarize the following into exactly three bullet points: "The city council approved a new transit plan on Tuesday. It adds two tram lines, extends night bus service to 2am, and raises fares by 5% starting in April. Opponents argue the fare increase penalises low-income riders, while supporters say the revenue is needed to fund the expansion."
Convert this ingredient list into JSON objects with name, quantity and unit: "200 g flour, 2 eggs, 150 ml milk, 1 tsp salt"
Extract the company names mentioned: "After Northwind acquired Contoso in 2021, Fabrikam remained its main competitor."
Rewrite this address as JSON with street, city, postcode and country: "48 Rue Lafayette, 75009 Paris, France"
Parse this into JSON with fields title, author and year: "Dune, written by Frank Herbert, was published in 1965."
Write a SQL INSERT for a table users(name, email, age) from: "Add Priya Nair, priya@example.com, aged 29."
Extract all numeric quantities with their units from: "The room is 4.2 m wide, 3 m tall, and holds up to 12 people for 90 minutes."
